## Checklist

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx eslint src tests e2e` and `npm test` pass (GitHub also runs the end-to-end tests)
- [ ] A test covers the fix or the new calculation
- [ ] An entry in `RELEASES` (`src/lib/whatsNew.ts`) if a user would notice the change
- [ ] No vendor or Visio artwork, and no real client data, in the change
- [ ] No new dependency (or it was discussed in an issue first, and `npm run notices` was run)
